evidence.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source 25 cm Biped You Train with Reinforcement Learning

summary: Hugging Face introduced Microduck, a 25‑cm bipedal robot priced at $399 and released with fully open‑source hardware and software. The platform enables developers and researchers to train reinforcement‑learning agents directly on a physical robot.
title: Hugging Face launches $399 open-source Microduck biped robot for reinforcement‑learning training
